text:
MESSAGE::type
Description
This command returns the type of the current message. For example, for
SIP request, it will return ‘request’. This is valid for messages of
the following protocols:
DIAMETER
MQTT
SIP
Syntax
MESSAGE
::
type
Examples
when
MR_INGRESS
{
log
local0.
"[MESSAGE::proto] [MESSAGE::type]"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
MR_INGRESS, MR_EGRESS, MR_FAILED
